verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official Code API for web that lets your own code trigger actions and modify object properties in a scene. It also provides the `<spline-viewer>` web component and code exports for Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber, which together act as a web runtime SDK. Coverage is narrow: it is web-runtime only, with no evidence of a programmatic platform API (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404) or of native mobile SDKs, even though the docs claim shipping to iOS and Android. Missing for 10: native iOS/Android SDK documentation, a server/management API with an official SDK, named and versioned SDK packages with reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
